notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible, if needed.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to Sporeweb Weaver.
Sporeweb Weaver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
